title: Roveia button
description: A fully rounded pill button with a small arrow: electric blue that lightens on hover, or ink that turns blue (0.5s). 52px for heroes and CTAs, 40px for the nav and card pills.
notes: renders an <a> when href is set
name: roveia-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: electric blue, lightens on hover · dark: ink pill that turns blue on hover

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 40px (nav, card pills) · lg: 52px (hero and CTA)

props.name: arrow
props.description: arrow after the label: right (→, default), up-right (↗) or none
